title: Reliability Gaps Between Groups in COMPAS Dataset
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any measurements related to faith or religion. Its focus is on inter-rater reliability gaps between racial groups in a criminal justice dataset.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The key findings relate to the discovery of systematic inter-rater reliability gaps between racial groups (White and non-White) in the COMPAS dataset, with the direction of the gap depending on the statistical measure used (e.g., Cohen's Kappa vs. PABAK).
